COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Making Important Choices is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Making Important Choices as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices.
   C. Explain Making Important Choices with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Making Important Choices never happens in Kenya.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

   D. Explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Treat Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen.

7. Which statement about Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup as rumours only.

   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

9. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore prices in shops

----
